list: The official 55 trophies, as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agreeing on every name, description and grade). Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them; guides are written for this entry in the author's own words and cite their sources.
sources_note: Every guide cites the official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles) for what the trophy asks for, and, where a method relies on how Grand Theft Auto games work, the GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for series mechanics such as mission replay and the wanted system. No guide copies text from another guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order (story, then side strands and activities, then collectibles and cleanup) and this pops last. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game. It cannot be missed: playing the story from the start takes you through it, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. Chapter trophies are story progress: finish every mission in the chapter and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. Nothing here is missable. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, it pops when the chapter's final mission is done — keep following the story and it comes on its own. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The chapter trophies are pure story progress — no side requirement, no missable step. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale — finish the chapter's missions in order and it pops at the close. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. It is a gold trophy and the story's end point — there is no way to miss it, since the story must be completed to reach the post-game cleanup stages. After it pops, the open world stays available for the remaining trophies. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for the series' post-story free roam.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — post-story free roam

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop when the named mission is finished — play it when the story offers it. If you ever need to redo a mission, Grand Theft Auto games let you replay story missions from the pause menu. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops at the mission's end — follow the story until this heist unlocks and finish it. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Mission trophies are straightforward: finish the named mission when the story reaches it. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends — keep playing the story in order and it will come. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. VCIA is Vice City International Airport — the mission's name tells you where it happens. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other mission trophies, it pops at the mission's end — no extra condition. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the in-game stats page tracks it. This is the last gold before the platinum: it needs the story, the side strands, the activities and the collectibles all done, so treat it as the cleanup goal and check the stats page to see what is left. It is a gold trophy. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how GTA games count 100% completion.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — 100% completion tracking

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long air time and similar driving feats, counted cumulatively. Do them naturally while driving between missions, then grind the remainder on open roads and ramps: a stunt counts each time the game registers one, so fast cars and jumps build the total. It is a silver trophy. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how GTA games register stunts.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — stunt registration

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish them. The official count is 9 types; work through them (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, drone races and the rest) and the trophy pops after the ninth. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 9-type count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. That is the official count — 42 challenges, each needing gold. Visit the shooting range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and retry any you miss; challenges can be repeated until you gold them. It is a silver trophy. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 42-challenge count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. The official count is 14 race locations — win one race at each. Races can be retried, so a loss costs nothing but time; learn each course's line and gates before pushing for the win. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 14-location count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida; each first win counts. Pick a fast, stable car for each race type and retry the ones you lose. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest against the character Cal. Out-fish him in the challenge (bigger or more catches, as the challenge scores it) and the trophy pops. If you lose, challenge him again. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine, any title. You do not need a high score, just a completed run. Pick the shortest or easiest cabinet you find and play it through. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand. Andy is a side character with his own mission strand — play his missions when they appear until the strand ends, and this pops at the last one. Side strands can be done any time after they unlock, including after the story. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand. Play Kenton's missions in order until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the last mission. Side strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand. Work through Billy's missions until the strand's finale — the trophy pops there. Like the other character strands, it can be finished after the main story. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the Strangers & Freaks side content, the series' classic stranger missions. The official count is 8 strands; find the stranger markers around the map and finish each strand. It is a silver trophy. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for the Strangers & Freaks format.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — Strangers & Freaks

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions in order until the strand ends — the trophy pops at the finale. Side strands remain open after the story. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand. Finish Tyrone's missions in order until the strand's last mission — that is when this pops. Side strands can be completed after the main story. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The official count is 18 spots — visit each and meditate there. Meditation spots are a collectible-style checklist, so tick them off as you explore; none is missable and all stay available after the story. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 18-spot count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific hunt Bret asks for. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, track the animal and take it down. It is a single hunt, not a set, so one successful kill does it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — find the cards scattered around Leonida and finish three full sets. Cards are a collectible: pick them up as you explore and track which sets are close to done. It is a silver trophy, and no card is missable. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — the in-world photo/tagging activity, done at 100 distinct spots. The official count is 100 locations; work through the map and WAiNK at each new spot you reach. It is a silver trophy and nothing here is missable. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's challenge list, counted cumulatively. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more; knock out the easy ones first and the total climbs as you play. The official count is 50. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it — escape the police until the stars clear. Do it somewhere with room to run (open roads, water or rough ground to break line of sight), and keep your partner close until the heat is gone. It can be retried, so a failed escape costs nothing. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how wanted levels clear.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — wanted level

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the attempt: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner WITHOUT losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay active through all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each fast, and do not let the stars clear between them; if the wanted level drops, the attempt fails and you start over. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how wanted levels work.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in or get close to 100 distinct vehicle types so the game logs them. The official count is 100; drive everything you see, visit showrooms, car parks and docks, and the total climbs. Nothing is missable. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — one activation, five takedowns. Find a spot with at least five enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus and chain the kills before it ends. It can be retried, so keep attempting it in busy fights. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the moment: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — leave the airport by an unofficial route, such as taking off or driving out somewhere other than the normal exit, instead of leaving the usual way. Do it while you are at VCIA during the story; if you leave normally, replay the mission or return to the airport and try the unscheduled exit. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for mission replay.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — mission replay

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tank. The description is a joke about how hot it gets inside a Rhino; in practice, get into (or take on) a Rhino tank and survive the encounter. Tanks appear at high wanted levels and military spots — steal one or destroy one and the trophy pops. It can be retried. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for the Rhino tank.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — Rhino tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the attempt: rob a jewelry store without being detected — get in, take the goods and get out with no alarm and no one spotting you. Plan the approach, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and move quietly; if you are detected, the attempt fails and you must try again. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate vault robberies, each ending with a clean getaway. The official count is 5. Plan each job (entry, vault, escape route) and lose the wanted level after each one; the count is cumulative, so failed attempts do not reset it. It is a silver trophy. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how wanted levels clear.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — wanted level

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — stop a truck, get its cargo and lose the wanted level. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; block one, crack it open and get away clean. One successful job does it, and it can be retried. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how wanted levels clear.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — wanted level

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit all 52 areas of the state. The official count is 52 areas; the map tracks which you have found, so drive, fly and sail into every corner, including the small towns and islands, until the count is complete. Nothing is missable. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 52-area count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one operation per gang, 9 total. The official count is 9 gangs; find each gang's operation, rob it and escape. The count is cumulative, so work through the gangs one at a time. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) for how wanted levels clear.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
GTA Wiki (gta.fandom.com) — wanted level

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — go to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It is a one-off moment, not a grind: find the right spot, have the drink and the trophy pops. It can be done any time. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the attempt: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out, the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom, build speed inside and go through the front; if you stop or get out, the attempt fails and you try again. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there and see it through to the end. You do not need a particular score, just a completed game at that alley. It can be done any time. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat where the partnership lands with the public. This pops during the story when that partnership moment plays out; keep following the story and it comes on its own. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the sense that choices are one-time: this tracks choices made, with PlayStation counting up to 500. Make choices as the story offers them — dialogue and mission decisions — and the count climbs; a choice you pass up is gone for that playthrough, so take the decisions when they appear rather than skipping them. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 500 count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on the second try after failing the first. This pops when a retry lands: fail an attempt at a story moment or activity, then succeed on the very next try. It comes naturally if you retry things instead of reloading an old save. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the sense that it is a one-time strange event: witness something odd — the description's 'What the hell just happened?' points to a scripted weird encounter. Pay attention during the story and free roam for unusual events; if you walk past one without triggering it, you may need to replay the mission or revisit the spot. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE in the attempt: bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon as you pass and connect; if you miss or stop, drive around and try again. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the official amount is $250,000, counted cumulatively. Collect marked bills from jobs and launder them through your contacts; the total builds over the game, so keep laundering as you earn. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the official amount is $100,000, counted cumulatively across every shop type. Buy weapons, clothes, cars and upgrades as you play; the total climbs on its own, and a late-game spending spree finishes it. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — the official count is 8 garages. Buy each one as it becomes available (they unlock through the story and as you earn money); the trophy pops when the eighth is yours. None is missable. Sources: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles); the 8-garage count is the figure PlayStation tracks for this trophy.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the official count is 10. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you find or own; each new registration counts, so work through different vehicle types until ten are in. Nothing is missable. Source: official trophy description (PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles).
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation, via Exophase / PSNProfiles
